I Tried Requesting an Icon Creation
Creating a writer's face, an icon!

I have felt that for writers, social media users, and anyone sharing content, many icons are easy to understand, such as their own face or a character's face that shows what they do. So, I decided to create an icon when I restarted my writing and opened my Twitter account!
In this article, I introduce tips on how to share your vision through the icon creation process. I hope you read it to the end!
Where did I find someone to create the icon?
I searched on Instagram and requested it on Coconala.

I use Instagram often, so when I found an illustrator whose style matched the image of the icon I wanted to create, I thought, 'This is the one!' I learned from their profile that they were offering services on Coconala, so I made the request there.
